Treatment summary
Patient presented three times following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. The
reported mechanism, a direct impact to the knee area, is consistent in kind and force with the injury described. Treatment has
extended somewhat longer than is typical for this type of knee injury, and the course is reviewed accordingly. On examination,
several findings support a true injury to the knee, including localized tenderness and reduced range of motion, while other
stability and neurovascular tests were within normal limits. The patient's history notes a minor strain in the same rgeion many
years ago that resolved completely with no lasting effects, and this has been considered in the assessment. Billing entries showing
two similar charges on the same date of service are being verified with the billing office before any further claims processing.
Plan going forward includes continued physical therapy, activity modification, and reassessment at the next scheduled visit to
monitor progress and functional recovery.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
